questions.question: You wrote: "Implemented React component libraries from Figma designs with Tailwind CSS.". Walk me through the hardest React problem in that work: what broke, how you diagnosed it, and what you would do differently now.

This role needs TypeScript. Your resume shows: listed on resume but no work experience shows it. Tell me about any TypeScript work that isn't on the resume, and how you would ramp up in your first month.

You wrote: "Built patient-portal features in React and JavaScript with Redux and Storybook.". Walk me through the hardest JavaScript problem in that work: what broke, how you diagnosed it, and what you would do differently now.
We also use Next.js, GraphQL, Jest or Cypress. Which of these have you touched, and how do you usually pick up a new tool on a deadline?
Why are you looking to move on from Lakeshore Health, and what would make this Senior Frontend Engineer a step up for you?
